name: Nantong Chaoda Equipment Co.,Ltd.
summary: Nantong Chaoda Equipment Co.,Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise primarily engaged in the design, development, and distribution of a wide array of molds and tooling for the automotive sector. The company's core expertise involves crafting molds for various vehicle interior and exterior components. This encompasses essential parts such as instrument panels, headliners, floor carpets, door trim panels, center consoles, left and right side panels, spare tire covers, and interior linings for both luggage and engine compartments, alongside tooling for automotive sound and heat insulation materials. Beyond these, Nantong Chaoda also provides specialized soft trim forming punching dies, molds for foamed automotive seating components (including backrests, cushions, headrests, and armrests), and precision inspection tools for vehicle models, assembly, and interior parts. Their extensive portfolio further includes custom non-standard tooling, automated manufacturing equipment, and enclosures for new energy vehicle batteries. Established in 2005, Nantong Chaoda Equipment Co.,Ltd. conducts its operations from its base in Rugao, China.
